hindi: सत्य से पृथ्वी थामी हुई है, सूर्य से द्युलोक थामा हुआ है; ऋत से आदित्य स्थित हैं और सोम द्युलोक में आश्रित है।
english: By truth the earth is held up, by the sun the sky is held up; by order (ṛta) the Ādityas stand, and Soma is set in heaven.
notes: ṛta rendered "order"; also "truth/right". adhi śritaḥ taken as "set upon/resting in" heaven.
lines_deva: स॒त्येनोत्त॑भिता॒ भूमिः॒ सूर्ये॒णोत्त॑भिता॒ द्यौः
ऋ॒तेना॑दि॒त्यास्ति॑ष्ठन्ति दि॒वि सोमो॒ अधि॑ श्रि॒तः
lines_iast: sa̱tyenotta̭bhitā̱ bhūmi̱ḥ sūrye̱ṇotta̭bhitā̱ dyauḥ
ṛ̱tenā̭di̱tyāsti̭ṣṭhanti di̱vi somo̱ adhi̭ śri̱taḥ

hindi: सोम से आदित्य बलवान् हैं, सोम से पृथ्वी महती है; और इन नक्षत्रों की गोद में सोम स्थापित है।
english: By Soma the Ādityas are strong, by Soma the earth is great; and in the lap of these stars Soma is placed.
lines_deva: सोमे॑नादि॒त्या ब॒लिनः॒ सोमे॑न पृथि॒वी म॒ही
अथो॒ नक्ष॑त्राणामे॒षामु॒पस्थे॒ सोम॒ आहि॑तः
lines_iast: somḙnādi̱tyā ba̱lina̱ḥ somḙna pṛthi̱vī ma̱hī
atho̱ nakṣa̭trāṇāme̱ṣāmu̱pasthe̱ soma̱ āhi̭taḥ

hindi: जब लोग ओषधि को कूटते-पीसते हैं, तब पीने वाला समझता है कि उसने सोम पी लिया; पर जिस सोम को ब्रह्मा-पुरोहित जानते हैं, उसमें से कोई पार्थिव नहीं खाता।
english: When they crush the herb together, the one who has drunk thinks he has drunk Soma; but the Soma that the brahmans know, of that no earthly one eats.
notes: "Soma" appears both as the plant-herb crushed and as the Soma known to the brahmans; the text sets them in contrast. brahmāṇaḥ = nom. pl. of brahman (m.) "priest"; alternatively "sacred utterances". pārthivaḥ "earthly one" (belonging to the earth).
lines_deva: सोमं॑ मन्यते पपि॒वान् यत् सं॑पिं॒षन्त्योष॑धिम्
सोमं॒ यं ब्र॒ह्माणो॑ वि॒दुर्न तस्या॑श्नाति॒ पार्थि॑वः
lines_iast: soma̭ṃ manyate papi̱vān yat sa̭ṃpi̱ṃṣantyoṣa̭dhim
soma̱ṃ yaṃ bra̱hmāṇo̭ vi̱durna tasyā̭śnāti̱ pārthi̭vaḥ

hindi: हे सोम, जब वे तुम्हें पी जाते हैं, तब तुम वहाँ से फिर बढ़ जाते हो। वायु सोम का रक्षक है; मास वर्षों का आकार है।
english: When they drink you forth, O Soma, from there you swell up again. Vāyu is the guardian of Soma; the month is the form of the years.
notes: samānām: taken as gen. pl. of samā "year"; ākṛtiḥ "form/shape" (the text gives no more). Vāyu: wind/god Vāyu.
lines_deva: यत् त्वा॑ सोम प्र॒पिब॑न्ति॒ तत॒ आ प्या॑यसे॒ पुनः॑
वा॒युः सोम॑स्य रक्षि॒ता समा॑नां॒ मास॒ आकृ॑तिः
lines_iast: yat tvā̭ soma pra̱piba̭nti̱ tata̱ ā pyā̭yase̱ puna̭ḥ
vā̱yuḥ soma̭sya rakṣi̱tā samā̭nā̱ṃ māsa̱ ākṛ̭tiḥ

hindi: हे सोम, तुम आच्छादन के विधानों से गुप्त और बार्हतों से रक्षित हो; केवल ग्रावाओं को सुनते हुए तुम स्थित रहते हो; कोई पार्थिव तुम्हें नहीं खाता।
english: Guarded by covering-arrangements, protected by the Bārhata ones, O Soma; hearing only the pressing-stones you stand; no earthly one eats of you.
notes: ācchad-vidhānaiḥ: "by covering-arrangements" (the compound is not further explained). bārhataiḥ: "of/by the bṛhat" (kind of verse or chant); noun left unstated. te: gen. "of you" (partitive with aśnāti).
lines_deva: आ॒च्छद्वि॑धानैर्गुपि॒तो बार्ह॑तैः सोम रक्षि॒तः
ग्राव्णा॒मिच्छृ॒ण्वन् ति॑ष्ठसि॒ न ते॑ अश्नाति॒ पार्थि॑वः
lines_iast: ā̱cchadvi̭dhānairgupi̱to bārha̭taiḥ soma rakṣi̱taḥ
grāvṇā̱micchṛ̱ṇvan ti̭ṣṭhasi̱ na tḙ aśnāti̱ pārthi̭vaḥ

hindi: चित्त तकिया था, चक्षु अञ्जन था; द्यौ और भूमि कोश थे, जब सूर्या पति के पास गई।
english: Thought was the pillow, sight was the unguent; sky and earth were the chest, when Sūryā went to her husband.
notes: The particle ā after citti/cakṣu is unclear (not translated); possibly stands for "was". Sūryā treated as a name (the sun-maiden). kośa: chest/casket/treasury.
lines_deva: चित्ति॑रा उप॒बर्ह॑णं॒ चक्षु॑रा अ॒भ्यञ्ज॑नम्
द्यौर्भूमिः॒ कोश॑ आसी॒द् यदया॑त् सू॒र्या पति॑म्
lines_iast: citti̭rā upa̱barha̭ṇa̱ṃ cakṣṷrā a̱bhyañja̭nam
dyaurbhūmi̱ḥ kośa̭ āsī̱d yadayā̭t sū̱ryā pati̭m

hindi: रैभी अनुदेयी थी, नाराशंसी न्योचनी थी; सूर्या का वस्त्र सचमुच सुन्दर था; वह गाथा से सजी हुई चलती है।
english: Raibhī was the anudeyī, Nārāśaṃsī the nyocanī. Sūryā's garment was indeed fair; adorned with a gāthā (song) she goes.
notes: anudeyī and nyocanī are left as transliterated; sense uncertain (anudeyī: "that which is given along", nyocanī unclear). Raibhī and Nārāśaṃsī are feminine words kept transliterated; later tradition links them to kinds of verse, which this line does not state. Tense shift was/goes is in the text. Subject of eti taken as Sūryā (pariṣkṛtā f.); gāthā could also be the instrument for the garment.
lines_deva: रैभ्या॑सीदनु॒देयी॑ नाराशं॒सी न्योच॑नी
सू॒र्याया॑ भ॒द्रमिद् वासो॒ गाथ॑यैति॒ परि॑ष्कृता
lines_iast: raibhyā̭sīdanu̱deyī̭ nārāśa̱ṃsī nyoca̭nī
sū̱ryāyā̭ bha̱dramid vāso̱ gātha̭yaiti̱ pari̭ṣkṛtā

hindi: स्तोम प्रतिधि थे; कुरीर और ओपश छन्द था। सूर्या के वर दोनों अश्विन् थे; अग्नि आगे चलने वाला था।
english: The stoma-chants were the pratidhis; the metre was the kurīra and the opaśa. The two Aśvins were Sūryā's wooers; Agni was the leader.
notes: Syntax of "kurīraṃ chanda opaśaḥ" is unclear: the senses of kurīra, opaśa and pratidhi are uncertain; chandas is the metre. Kept as transliterated. purogava: literally "ox in front", i.e. leader.
lines_deva: स्तोमा॑ आसन् प्रति॒धयः॑ कु॒रीरं॒ छन्द॑ ओप॒शः
सू॒र्याया॑ अ॒श्विना॑ व॒राग्निरा॑सीत् पुरोग॒वः
lines_iast: stomā̭ āsan prati̱dhaya̭ḥ ku̱rīra̱ṃ chanda̭ opa̱śaḥ
sū̱ryāyā̭ a̱śvinā̭ va̱rāgnirā̭sīt puroga̱vaḥ

hindi: सोम वधू की कामना करने वाला हुआ; दोनों अश्विन् वर थे, जब सविता ने मन से झुकी हुई सूर्या को पति को दे दिया।
english: Soma became the wooer, the two Aśvins were both wooers, when Savitar gave Sūryā, who was inclined in mind, to her husband.
notes: śaṃsantīm: "declaring/approving (her wish)"; manasā attached to it ("in mind"); alternatively "Savitar gave her with his mind". vadhūyuḥ "desiring a bride". Also possible: patye goes with śaṃsantīm ("declaring to the husband"); "inclined" is an interpretation of √śaṃs.
lines_deva: सोमो॑ वधू॒युर॑भवद॒श्विना॑स्तामु॒भा व॒रा
सू॒र्यां यत् पत्ये॒ शंस॑न्तीं॒ मन॑सा सवि॒ताद॑दात्
lines_iast: somo̭ vadhū̱yura̭bhavada̱śvinā̭stāmu̱bhā va̱rā
sū̱ryāṃ yat patye̱ śaṃsa̭ntī̱ṃ mana̭sā savi̱tāda̭dāt

hindi: उसका मन गाड़ी था और द्यौ आवरण था; दो उज्ज्वल गाड़ी खींचने वाले बैल थे, जब सूर्या पति के पास गई।
english: Her mind was the cart, and the sky was the covering; the two bright draught-oxen were there, when Sūryā went to her husband.
lines_deva: मनो॑ अस्या॒ अन॑ आसी॒द् द्यौरा॑सीदु॒त च्छ॒दिः
शु॒क्राव॑न॒ड्वाहा॑वास्तां॒ यदया॑त् सू॒र्या पति॑म्
lines_iast: mano̭ asyā̱ ana̭ āsī̱d dyaurā̭sīdu̱ta ccha̱diḥ
śu̱krāva̭na̱ḍvāhā̭vāstā̱ṃ yadayā̭t sū̱ryā pati̭m

words.gloss: by the Ṛc and the Sāman

hindi: ऋक् और साम से जुड़े हुए तुम्हारे दोनों बैल दो सामन् हो गए; दोनों कान तुम्हारे दोनों चक्र थे; द्युलोक में मार्ग आने-जाने वाला है।
english: Your two oxen, set with the Ṛc and the Sāman, became/went as the pair of sāmans; the two ears were your two wheels; in heaven the path is a moving to and fro.
notes: "sāmanāvaitām" is unclear: read sāmanau + aitām (3 du. impf. √i), sense uncertain; "carācara" literally "moving and fixed" or "moving to and fro" (here taken as to and fro). "gāvau": dual of go, "two oxen/cattle". The grouping of subject and predicate in the first line is not certain.
lines_deva: ऋ॒क्सा॒माभ्या॑म॒भिहि॑तौ॒ गावौ॑ ते साम॒नावै॑ताम्
श्रोत्रे॑ ते च॒क्रे आ॑स्तां दि॒वि पन्था॑श्चराच॒रः
lines_iast: ṛ̱ksā̱mābhyā̭ma̱bhihi̭tau̱ gāvaṷ te sāma̱nāvai̭tām
śrotrḙ te ca̱kre ā̭stāṃ di̱vi panthā̭ścarāca̱raḥ

words.gram: f. nom. sg. pres. part. pra-√i

hindi: तुम्हारे दोनों चक्र उज्ज्वल थे; चलते समय व्यान अक्ष में जुड़ा हुआ था। सूर्या मन से बनी गाड़ी पर चढ़ी और पति की ओर चली।
english: Bright were your two wheels in going; vyāna (a breath) was the axle fixed in. Sūryā mounted the cart made of mind, going forth to her husband.
notes: yātyā: form unclear (read as "in going"); possibly agrees with another noun. vyāna is a named breath; left as the name. manasmaya "mind-made/consisting of mind".
lines_deva: शुची॑ ते च॒क्रे या॒त्या व्या॒नो अक्ष॒ आह॑तः
अनो॑ मन॒स्मयं॑ सू॒र्यारो॑हत् प्रय॒ती पति॑म्
lines_iast: śucī̭ te ca̱kre yā̱tyā vyā̱no akṣa̱ āha̭taḥ
ano̭ mana̱smaya̭ṃ sū̱ryāro̭hat praya̱tī pati̭m

hindi: सूर्या की बारात चल पड़ी, जिसे सविता ने भेजा। मघाओं में गायें मारी जाती हैं, फल्गुनियों में ले जाया जाता है।
english: Sūryā's bridal procession set out, which Savitar sent forth. In the Maghās the cattle are struck; in the Phalgunīs it is carried off.
notes: Maghā and Phalgunī are names of lunar mansions (plural here), kept as names. Subject of vyūhyate (vi + ūhyate, written vyu'hyate) is not stated: "it/she is carried away/apart". vahatu: bridal procession/conveyance.
lines_deva: सू॒र्याया॑ वह॒तुः प्रागा॑त् सवि॒ता यम॒वासृ॑जत्
म॒घासु॑ ह॒न्यन्ते॒ गावः॒ फल्गु॑नीषु॒ व्युऽह्यते
lines_iast: sū̱ryāyā̭ vaha̱tuḥ prāgā̭t savi̱tā yama̱vāsṛ̭jat
ma̱ghāsṷ ha̱nyante̱ gāva̱ḥ phalgṷnīṣu̱ vyu'hyate

words.gram: m. nom. du. pres. part. mid. √prach

hindi: हे अश्विन्, जब तुम दोनों सूर्या की बारात के लिए पूछते हुए तीन चक्र वाले से गए, तब तुम्हारा एक चक्र कहाँ था? निर्देश करने के लिए तुम दोनों कहाँ खड़े हुए?
english: O Aśvins, when you two went asking, with a three-wheeled (conveyance), for Sūryā's bridal procession, where was your one wheel? Where did you two stand for the pointing (guiding)?
notes: "kva'deṣṭrāya": the avagraha is a pada-separation mark here (kva deṣṭrāya). deṣṭrāya: dative, "for the pointing/guide" (uncertain). The vehicle word for tricakreṇa is left unstated. Source has क्वऽदेष्ट्राय: in this edition ऽ elsewhere marks an elided a, so the pada might be kva + adeṣṭrāya; kept kva deṣṭrāya, not settled.
lines_deva: यद॑श्विना पृ॒च्छमा॑ना॒वया॑तं त्रिच॒क्रेण॑ वह॒तुं सू॒र्यायाः॑
क्वैकं॑ च॒क्रं वा॑मासी॒त् क्वऽदे॒ष्ट्राय॑ तस्थथुः
lines_iast: yada̭śvinā pṛ̱cchamā̭nā̱vayā̭taṃ trica̱kreṇa̭ vaha̱tuṃ sū̱ryāyā̭ḥ
kvaika̭ṃ ca̱kraṃ vā̭māsī̱t kva'de̱ṣṭrāya̭ tasthathuḥ

hindi: हे शोभा के स्वामी दोनों, जब तुम सूर्या को वरने के लिए पहुँचे, तब सब देवों ने तुम दोनों के उस को अनुमोदन दिया; पुत्र पूषा ने पिता को चुना।
english: O lords of splendour, when you two went to Sūryā for wooing, all the gods assented to that of yours; Pūṣan, the son, chose his father.
notes: vareyam: unclear form, read "for wooing"; anu ajānan: "approved, assented". śubhaspatī: "lords of splendour/of the fair" (epithet of the Aśvins).
lines_deva: यदया॑तं शुभस्पती वरे॒यं सू॒र्यामुप॑
विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अनु॒ तद् वा॑मजानन् पु॒त्रः पि॒तर॑मवृणीत पू॒षा
lines_iast: yadayā̭taṃ śubhaspatī vare̱yaṃ sū̱ryāmupa̭
viśvḙ de̱vā anu̱ tad vā̭majānan pu̱traḥ pi̱tara̭mavṛṇīta pū̱ṣā

hindi: हे सूर्या, तुम्हारे दो चक्र हैं; उन्हें ब्रह्मा-पुरोहित ऋतु के अनुसार जानते हैं। पर जो एक चक्र गुहा में है, उसे केवल अद्धातयः जानते हैं।
english: Two are your wheels, O Sūryā; the brahmans know them season by season. But the one wheel that is hidden, that only the addhātayas know.
notes: sūrye: read as voc. of sūryā (alternative: loc. "in the sun"). addhātayaḥ: meaning uncertain, left transliterated ("knowers/those in truth"?). guhā: "in secret/hidden". brahmāṇaḥ as in unit 3.
lines_deva: द्वे ते॑ च॒क्रे सूर्ये॑ ब्र॒ह्माण॑ ऋतु॒था वि॑दुः
अथैकं॑ च॒क्रं यद् गुहा॒ तद॑द्धा॒तय॒ इद् वि॒दुः
lines_iast: dve tḙ ca̱kre sūryḙ bra̱hmāṇa̭ ṛtu̱thā vi̭duḥ
athaika̭ṃ ca̱kraṃ yad guhā̱ tada̭ddhā̱taya̱ id vi̱duḥ

hindi: हम अर्यमा की, सुबन्धु और पति दिलाने वाले की, पूजा करते हैं। उर्वारुक के समान बन्धन से मैं यहाँ से मुक्त करता हूँ, वहाँ से नहीं।
english: We worship Aryaman, of good kin, the finder of a husband. Like an urvāruka from its bond, from here I release (her), not from there.
notes: urvāruka: plant-fruit name kept untranslated, not identified. The object of muñcāmi is not stated (understood "her").
lines_deva: अ॒र्य॒मणं॑ यजामहे सुब॒न्धुं प॑ति॒वेद॑नम्
उ॒र्वा॒रु॒कमि॑व॒ बन्ध॑ना॒त् प्रेतो मु॑ञ्चामि॒ नामुतः॑
lines_iast: a̱rya̱maṇa̭ṃ yajāmahe suba̱ndhuṃ pa̭ti̱veda̭nam
u̱rvā̱ru̱kami̭va̱ bandha̭nā̱t preto mṷñcāmi̱ nāmuta̭ḥ

hindi: मैं यहाँ से मुक्त करता हूँ, वहाँ से नहीं; वहाँ मैंने उसे भली-भाँति बाँध दिया है, जिससे हे उदार इन्द्र, यह उत्तम पुत्रों वाली और सौभाग्यवती हो।
english: From here I release, not from there; I have made her well bound there, so that she, O bountiful Indra, may have good sons and be fortunate.
notes: amutaskaram read as amutaḥ + karam (1 sg. aor. "I have made"); alternative reading as one word. Object "her" understood.
lines_deva: प्रेतो मु॑ञ्चामि॒ नामुतः॑ सुब॒द्धाम॒मुत॑स्करम्
यथे॒यमि॑न्द्र मीढ्वः सुपु॒त्रा सु॒भगास॑ति
lines_iast: preto mṷñcāmi̱ nāmuta̭ḥ suba̱ddhāma̱muta̭skaram
yathe̱yami̭ndra mīḍhvaḥ supu̱trā su̱bhagāsa̭ti

hindi: मैं तुम्हें वरुण के पाश से मुक्त करता हूँ, जिससे अति कल्याणकारी सविता ने तुम्हें बाँधा था। ऋत के स्थान में, सुकृत के लोक में तुम्हारे लिए सुख हो, सम्भला के साथ।
english: I release you from Varuṇa's noose, with which the very gracious Savitar bound you. In the seat of order (ṛta), in the world of good deeds, may it be pleasant for you, together with Saṃbhalā.
notes: sahasaṃbhalāyai: unclear; read as one word "saha-saṃbhalāyai" (dative) meaning "for one together with Saṃbhala(ā)" or saha + dative (an irregular construction); Saṃbhala appears as a name in unit 31. suśevāḥ: nom. sg. in -āḥ, read "very kind".
lines_deva: प्र त्वा॑ मुञ्चामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ पाशा॒द् येन॒ त्वाब॑ध्नात् सवि॒ता सु॒शेवाः॑
ऋ॒तस्य॒ योनौ॑ सुकृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒के स्यो॒नं ते॑ अस्तु स॒हसं॑भलायै
lines_iast: pra tvā̭ muñcāmi̱ varṷṇasya̱ pāśā̱d yena̱ tvāba̭dhnāt savi̱tā su̱śevā̭ḥ
ṛ̱tasya̱ yonaṷ sukṛ̱tasya̭ lo̱ke syo̱naṃ tḙ astu sa̱hasa̭ṃbhalāyai

hindi: भग तुम्हें हाथ पकड़कर यहाँ से ले जाए; दोनों अश्विन् तुम्हें रथ से आगे ले चलें। घरों को जाओ, जिससे तुम गृहपत्नी हो; तुम अधिकार रखने वाली होकर सभा में बोलोगी।
english: May Bhaga lead you from here, taking you by the hand; may the two Aśvins carry you forth in a chariot. Go to the houses (home), that you may be mistress of the house; being in control, you shall address the assembly.
notes: gṛhān: plural, "to the houses/home". vidatha: "assembly, gathering" (meaning debated); ā vadāsi "you shall speak (to)". hastagṛhya: absolutive.
lines_deva: भग॑स्त्वे॒तो न॑यतु हस्त॒गृह्या॒श्विना॑ त्वा॒ प्र व॑हतां॒ रथे॑न
गृ॒हान् ग॑च्छ गृ॒हप॑त्नी॒ यथासो॑ व॒शिनी॒ त्वं वि॒दथ॒मा व॑दासि
lines_iast: bhaga̭stve̱to na̭yatu hasta̱gṛhyā̱śvinā̭ tvā̱ pra va̭hatā̱ṃ rathḙna
gṛ̱hān ga̭ccha gṛ̱hapa̭tnī̱ yathāso̭ va̱śinī̱ tvaṃ vi̱datha̱mā va̭dāsi

hindi: यहाँ तुम्हारी सन्तान के लिए प्रिय वस्तु बढ़े; इस घर में गृहपति-भाव के लिए जागरूक रहो। इस पति के साथ अपने शरीर को मिलाओ; फिर वृद्ध होकर तुम सभा में बोलोगी।
english: Here let what is dear prosper for your offspring; in this house be watchful for householdership. With this husband unite your body; and then, grown old, you shall address the assembly.
notes: gārhapatya: "householdership" (also the name of the household fire; here rendered by the state). jirviḥ: "aged" (uncertain form). tanvam has the svarita numeral mark 1 in the source.
lines_deva: इ॒ह प्रि॒यं प्र॒जायै॑ ते॒ समृ॑ध्यताम॒स्मिन् गृ॒हे गार्ह॑पत्याय जागृहि
ए॒ना पत्या॑ त॒न्वं॑१ सं स्पृ॑श॒स्वाथ॒ जिर्वि॑र्वि॒दथ॒मा व॑दासि
lines_iast: i̱ha pri̱yaṃ pra̱jāyai̭ te̱ samṛ̭dhyatāma̱smin gṛ̱he gārha̭patyāya jāgṛhi
e̱nā patyā̭ ta̱nva̭ṃ1 saṃ spṛ̭śa̱svātha̱ jirvi̭rvi̱datha̱mā va̭dāsi

words.gram: m. nom. du. pres. part. mid. √mud

hindi: यहीं रहो, एक-दूसरे से अलग मत होओ; पूरी आयु प्राप्त करो, पुत्रों और नातियों के साथ खेलते और आनन्द मनाते हुए, अपने घर में।
english: Stay right here, do not part from each other; attain the full lifespan, playing with sons and grandsons, rejoicing, at home.
notes: svastakau: unclear (read "in their own home", dual nom.). The avagraha in vya'śnutam marks vi + aśnutam.
lines_deva: इ॒हैव स्तं॒ मा वि यौ॑ष्टं॒ विश्व॒मायु॒र्व्यऽश्नुतम्
क्रीड॑न्तौ पु॒त्रैर्नप्तृ॑भि॒र्मोद॑मानौ स्वस्त॒कौ
lines_iast: i̱haiva sta̱ṃ mā vi yaṷṣṭa̱ṃ viśva̱māyu̱rvya'śnutam
krīḍa̭ntau pu̱trairnaptṛ̭bhi̱rmoda̭mānau svasta̱kau

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. vi-√dhā

hindi: ये दोनों बालक माया से आगे-पीछे चलते हैं और खेलते हुए समुद्र के चारों ओर जाते हैं। एक सब भुवनों को देखता है; दूसरा ऋतुओं को विधान करता हुआ तुम नया जन्म लेते हो।
english: These two children move forward and back by their wondrous power (māyā) and, playing, go around the ocean. One looks over all the beings; the other, ordering the seasons, you are born anew.
notes: The second line shifts from "the other" (third person) to "you" (jāyase, 2 sg.); translated literally. māyā: "wondrous/creative power". arṇava: flood/ocean.
lines_deva: पू॒र्वा॒प॒रं च॑रतो मा॒ययै॒तौ शिशू॒ क्रीड॑न्तौ॒ परि॑ यातोऽर्ण॒वम्
विश्वा॒न्यो भुव॑ना वि॒चष्ट॑ ऋ॒तूंर॒न्यो वि॒दध॑ज्जायसे॒ नवः॑
lines_iast: pū̱rvā̱pa̱raṃ ca̭rato mā̱yayai̱tau śiśū̱ krīḍa̭ntau̱ pari̭ yāto'rṇa̱vam
viśvā̱nyo bhuva̭nā vi̱caṣṭa̭ ṛ̱tūṃra̱nyo vi̱dadha̭jjāyase̱ nava̭ḥ

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. ā-√i

hindi: तुम उत्पन्न होते हुए नित्य नए होते हो; तुम दिनों के केतु हो और उषाओं के आगे-आगे जाते हो। आते हुए तुम देवों के लिए भाग बाँटते हो; हे चन्द्रमा, तुम दीर्घ आयु बढ़ाते हो।
english: Ever new you become, being born; you are the banner of the days and go at the front of the dawns. Coming, you apportion a share to the gods; O Moon, you prolong a long life.
notes: candramaḥ is explicit in the line; the earlier lines address the same "you".
lines_deva: नवो॑नवो भवसि॒ जाय॑मा॒नोऽह्नां॑ के॒तुरु॒षसा॑मे॒ष्यग्र॑म्
भा॒गं दे॒वेभ्यो॒ वि द॑धास्या॒यन् प्र च॑न्द्रमस्तिरसे दी॒र्घमायुः॑
lines_iast: navo̭navo bhavasi̱ jāya̭mā̱no'hnā̭ṃ ke̱turu̱ṣasā̭me̱ṣyagra̭m
bhā̱gaṃ de̱vebhyo̱ vi da̭dhāsyā̱yan pra ca̭ndramastirase dī̱rghamāyṷḥ

words.gloss: kṛtyā (that which is made; sense uncertain)

hindi: शामुल्य को दे दो; ब्रह्म-पुरोहितों को धन बाँट दो। यह कृत्या पैरों वाली होकर पत्नी के रूप में पति में प्रवेश करती है।
english: Give away the śāmulya; apportion the wealth to the priests. This kṛtyā, having become endowed with feet, enters the husband as a wife.
notes: śāmulya: meaning uncertain, left transliterated. kṛtyā: literally "what is made"; kept transliterated. brahmabhyaḥ: dat. pl. of brahman (m.) "priests", or n. "sacred utterances". The referent of eṣā is not stated.
lines_deva: परा॑ देहि शामु॒ल्यं ब्र॒ह्मभ्यो॒ वि भ॑जा॒ वसु॑
कृ॒त्यैषा प॒द्वती॑ भू॒त्वा जा॒या वि॑शते॒ पति॑म्
lines_iast: parā̭ dehi śāmu̱lyaṃ bra̱hmabhyo̱ vi bha̭jā̱ vasṷ
kṛ̱tyaiṣā pa̱dvatī̭ bhū̱tvā jā̱yā vi̭śate̱ pati̭m

hindi: वह नील-लोहित होता है; कृत्या का लगाव प्रकट होता है। उसके ज्ञाति बढ़ते हैं, पति बन्धनों में बाँधा जाता है।
english: It becomes dark blue and red; the attachment of kṛtyā is made manifest. Her relatives prosper; the husband is bound in bonds.
notes: The subject of bhavati (neuter "it") is not stated. kṛtyā as in unit 25. vyajyate: vi + ajyate (avagraha in the source).
lines_deva: नी॒ल॒लो॒हि॒तं भ॑वति कृ॒त्यास॒क्तिर्व्यऽज्यते
एध॑न्ते अस्या ज्ञा॒तयः॒ पति॑र्ब॒न्धेषु॑ बध्यते
lines_iast: nī̱la̱lo̱hi̱taṃ bha̭vati kṛ̱tyāsa̱ktirvya'jyate
edha̭nte asyā jñā̱taya̱ḥ pati̭rba̱ndheṣṷ badhyate

hindi: शरीर अशुभ हो जाता है, चमकता हुआ, उस पापिनी के द्वारा; जब पति वधू के वस्त्र से अपने अंग को ढकता है।
english: The body becomes ill-omened, shining, by that evil one; when the husband covers his own limb with the bride's garment.
notes: The second line is a subordinate clause continuing the sentence; the main clause is not in this unit. vadhvo3 carries a pluta mark (3). "pāpayā amuyā": f. inst., referent (kṛtyā?) not stated; taken as "by that evil one". ruśatī could mean "white/bright".
lines_deva: अ॒श्ली॒ला त॒नूर्भ॑वति॒ रुश॑ती पा॒पया॑मु॒या
पति॒र्यद् व॒ध्वो॒३वास॑सः॒ स्वमङ्ग॑मभ्यूर्णु॒ते
lines_iast: a̱ślī̱lā ta̱nūrbha̭vati̱ ruśa̭tī pā̱payā̭mu̱yā
pati̱ryad va̱dhvo̱3vāsa̭sa̱ḥ svamaṅga̭mabhyūrṇu̱te

hindi: आशसन, विशसन और अधिविकर्तन; सूर्या के उन रूपों को देखो, उन्हें ब्रह्मा भी सजाता है।
english: Cutting, cutting apart, and cutting over: look at those forms of Sūryā; the Brahmā (priest) also adorns them.
notes: The three nouns are verbal nouns of cutting (exact sense uncertain). brahmota = brahmā + uta (alternative: neuter brahma "sacred utterance" + uta). Brahmā rendered as priest as in units 29 and 30.
lines_deva: आ॒शस॑नं वि॒शस॑न॒मथो॑ अधिवि॒कर्त॑नम्
सू॒र्यायाः॑ पश्य रू॒पाणि॒ तानि॑ ब्र॒ह्मोत शु॑म्भति
lines_iast: ā̱śasa̭naṃ vi̱śasa̭na̱matho̭ adhivi̱karta̭nam
sū̱ryāyā̭ḥ paśya rū̱pāṇi̱ tāni̭ bra̱hmota śṷmbhati

hindi: यह रूखा, तीखा, काँटेदार और विषैला है; यह खाने के लिए नहीं है। जो ब्रह्मा सूर्या को जानता है, वही वधू का वस्त्र पाने के योग्य है।
english: This is rough, sharp, barbed, poisonous; this is not for eating. The Brahmā (priest) who knows Sūryā alone deserves the bridal garment.
notes: tṛṣṭa, kaṭuka and apāṣṭhavat are adjectives of uncertain exact sense (rough/sharp/with barbs). What "this" refers to is not stated. vādhūya taken as "garment of the bride".
lines_deva: तृ॒ष्टमे॒तत् कटु॑कमपा॒ष्ठव॑द् वि॒षव॒न्नैतदत्त॑वे
सू॒र्यां यो ब्र॒ह्मा वेद॒ स इद् वाधू॑यमर्हति
lines_iast: tṛ̱ṣṭame̱tat kaṭṷkamapā̱ṣṭhava̭d vi̱ṣava̱nnaitadatta̭ve
sū̱ryāṃ yo bra̱hmā veda̱ sa id vādhṷ̄yamarhati

hindi: वही ब्रह्मा उस सुखद, अति मंगलकारी वस्त्र को ग्रहण करता है, जो उस प्रायश्चित्त का अध्ययन करता है जिससे पत्नी की हानि नहीं होती।
english: That Brahmā (priest) takes that pleasant, very auspicious garment, who recites the expiation (prāyaścitti) by which the wife is not harmed.
notes: "adhyeti" taken as "recites/studies".
lines_deva: स इत् तत् स्यो॒नं ह॑रति ब्र॒ह्मा वासः॑ सुम॒ङ्गल॑म्
प्राय॑श्चित्तिं॒ यो अ॒ध्येति॒ येन॑ जा॒या न रिष्य॑ति
lines_iast: sa it tat syo̱naṃ ha̭rati bra̱hmā vāsa̭ḥ suma̱ṅgala̭m
prāya̭ścitti̱ṃ yo a̱dhyeti̱ yena̭ jā̱yā na riṣya̭ti

words.gloss: O lord of the sacred utterance

hindi: तुम दोनों समृद्ध सौभाग्य को एक साथ लाओ, ऋत-वचनों में सत्य बोलते हुए। हे ब्रह्मणस्पति, इसके लिए पति को प्रिय बनाओ; सम्भल इस वाणी को सुन्दर रूप से बोले।
english: You two, bring together prosperous good fortune, speaking truth in true speeches. O Brahmaṇaspati, make the husband pleasing to her; let Saṃbhala speak this speech pleasingly.
notes: ṛtodyeṣu: ṛta + udya (from vac), "in true speeches" (uncertain compound). Brahmaṇaspati: transliterated name (lord of the brahman). Saṃbhala: name, role not stated. Bhaga (good fortune) is also a deity name elsewhere (unit 20); here "bhagam" the noun.
lines_deva: यु॒वं भगं॒ सं भ॑रतं॒ समृ॑द्धमृ॒तं वद॑न्तावृ॒तोद्ये॑षु
ब्रह्म॑णस्पते॒ पति॑म॒स्यै रो॑चय॒ चारु॑ संभ॒लो व॑दतु॒ वाच॑मे॒ताम्
lines_iast: yu̱vaṃ bhaga̱ṃ saṃ bha̭rata̱ṃ samṛ̭ddhamṛ̱taṃ vada̭ntāvṛ̱todyḙṣu
brahma̭ṇaspate̱ pati̭ma̱syai ro̭caya̱ cārṷ saṃbha̱lo va̭datu̱ vāca̭me̱tām

hindi: यहीं रहो, आगे दूर मत जाओ; हे गायो, इसे सन्तान के साथ बढ़ाओ। हे सुन्दरता से चलती हुई, उज्ज्वल, सोम की कान्ति वाली गायो, सब देवों ने यहाँ तुम्हारे मन स्थापित किए हैं।
english: Stay right here, do not go farther; make this one grow with offspring, O cows. Going splendidly, O bright cows with Soma-splendour, all the gods have set your minds here.
notes: The object of imam is not stated ("this one"). kran: read as 3 pl. aor. of √kṛ ("have made/set"); sense of "kṛ manāṃsi" taken as "set minds". usriyā: bright/milch cows. gāvaḥ addressed in the vocative.
lines_deva: इ॒हेद॑साथ॒ न प॒रो ग॑माथे॒मं गा॑वः प्र॒जया॑ वर्धयाथ
शुभं॑ यतीरु॒स्रियाः॒ सोम॑वर्चसो॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वाः क्रन्नि॒ह वो॒ मनां॑सि
lines_iast: i̱heda̭sātha̱ na pa̱ro ga̭māthe̱maṃ gā̭vaḥ pra̱jayā̭ vardhayātha
śubha̭ṃ yatīru̱sriyā̱ḥ soma̭varcaso̱ viśvḙ de̱vāḥ kranni̱ha vo̱ manā̭ṃsi

hindi: हे गायो, सन्तान के साथ इसमें प्रवेश करो; यह देवों के भाग को क्षीण नहीं करता। इसके लिए पूषा और सब मरुत्, इसके लिए धाता और सविता तुम्हें प्रेरित करें।
english: O cows, enter this one together with offspring; this one does not diminish the share of the gods. For him Pūṣan and all the Maruts, for him Dhātṛ and Savitṛ impel you.
notes: 'imam' (this one) is not named; the context is not given in the unit. 'suvāti' is singular with several subjects (agreement with the nearest); 'vaḥ' taken as the cows addressed in line a, object of suvāti (alternative: dative 'for you').
lines_deva: इ॒मं गा॑वः प्र॒जया॒ सं वि॑शाथा॒यं दे॒वानां॒ न मि॑नाति भा॒गम्
अ॒स्मै वः॑ पू॒षा म॒रुत॑श्च॒ सर्वे॑ अ॒स्मै वो॑ धा॒ता स॑वि॒ता सु॑वाति
lines_iast: i̱maṃ gā̭vaḥ pra̱jayā̱ saṃ vi̭śāthā̱yaṃ de̱vānā̱ṃ na mi̭nāti bhā̱gam
a̱smai va̭ḥ pū̱ṣā ma̱ruta̭śca̱ sarvḙ a̱smai vo̭ dhā̱tā sa̭vi̱tā sṷvāti

hindi: हमारे मित्र जिन मार्गों से विवाह-याचना के लिए जाते हैं, वे मार्ग काँटों से रहित और सीधे हों। भग, अर्यमा और धाता तेज से संयुक्त करें।
english: May the paths by which our friends go to the wooing be free of thorns and straight. May Bhaga, may Aryaman, may Dhātṛ join together with splendour.
notes: 'vareyam' taken as 'wooing' (alternatively 'the suitor/desirable one'). The object of 'saṃ sṛjatu' is not expressed in line b. 'anṛkṣarāḥ' glossed 'thornless' (anṛkṣara).
lines_deva: अ॒नृ॒क्ष॒रा ऋ॒जवः॑ सन्तु॒ पन्थ॑नो॒ येभिः॒ सखा॑यो॒ यन्ति॑ नो वरे॒यम्
सं भगे॑न॒ सम॑र्य॒म्णा सं धा॒ता सृ॑जतु॒ वर्च॑सा
lines_iast: a̱nṛ̱kṣa̱rā ṛ̱java̭ḥ santu̱ pantha̭no̱ yebhi̱ḥ sakhā̭yo̱ yanti̭ no vare̱yam
saṃ bhagḙna̱ sama̭rya̱mṇā saṃ dhā̱tā sṛ̭jatu̱ varca̭sā

hindi: जो तेज पासों में है और जो सुरा में रखा गया है, और जो तेज गायों में है, हे अश्विनो, उस तेज से इस स्त्री को अनुगृहीत करो।
english: The splendour that is in the dice, and that which is placed in surā, and the splendour that is in the cows, O Aśvins, with that splendour favour this woman.
notes: Token 'goṣva̱śvinā̱' = goṣu + aśvinā. Line a is a short line (about 12 syllables). 'imām' is only 'this (feminine)' in the unit; 'woman' is an inference.
lines_deva: यच्च॒ वर्चो॑ अ॒क्षेषु॒ सुरा॑यां च॒ यदाहि॑तम्
यद् गोष्व॒श्विना॒ वर्च॒स्तेने॒मां वर्च॑सावतम्
lines_iast: yacca̱ varco̭ a̱kṣeṣu̱ surā̭yāṃ ca̱ yadāhi̭tam
yad goṣva̱śvinā̱ varca̱stene̱māṃ varca̭sāvatam

words.gloss: by which (first part of yena; see text_flags)

hindi: जिससे महानग्नी का जघन-भाग, हे अश्विनो, अथवा जिससे सुरा, और जिससे पासे सींचे गए, उस तेज से इस स्त्री को अनुगृहीत करो।
english: That by which the hinder part of Mahānagnī, O Aśvins, or the surā, and that by which the dice were sprinkled: with that splendour favour this woman.

text_flags.why: possible: 'ye' and 'na' look like 'yena' (by which) printed with a space; compare 'yena' in the next line
possible: 'mahānagnī' (gen. mahānagnyāḥ) expected; 'gh' may be a misprint for 'g'

notes: Line a is elliptical and unclear: no verb is given and 'tena ... varcasā' in line b is the apparent main clause. 'Mahānagnī' is kept as a name or epithet, not explained. 'surā' appears as nominative here. Reading is doubtful. 'imām' is only 'this (feminine)' in the unit; 'woman' is an inference.
lines_deva: ये न॑ महान॒घ्न्या ज॒घन॒मश्वि॑ना॒ येन॑ वा॒ सुरा॑
येना॒क्षा अ॒भ्यषि॑च्यन्त॒ तेने॒मां वर्च॑सावतम्
lines_iast: ye na̭ mahāna̱ghnyā ja̱ghana̱maśvi̭nā̱ yena̭ vā̱ surā̭
yenā̱kṣā a̱bhyaṣi̭cyanta̱ tene̱māṃ varca̭sāvatam

words.gram: n. inst. sg. or acc. pl.

hindi: जो बिना ईंधन के जलों के भीतर दीप्त होता है, जिसकी विप्रजन यज्ञों में स्तुति करते हैं — हे अपां नपात्, वे मधुर जल दो जिनसे इन्द्र बढ़ा, वीरता से सहायता करने वाला होकर।
english: He who, without fuel, shines within the waters, whom the inspired ones praise at the sacrifices: O Apām Napāt, give the honeyed waters by which Indra grew strong, helping with heroic power.

text_flags.why: possible: the printed 'vīryā avān' is unclear; 'vīryāvān' (possessed of heroic power) would fit the sense

notes: The last word is uncertain: 'vīryā 'vān' = vīryā + avān (√av, to help) as printed; alternatively vīryāvān 'full of heroic power'. 'Apām napāt' (offspring of the waters) is kept as a name of the addressed deity. The digit 1 in 'apsva̭1ntaryaṃ' is the svarita mark.
lines_deva: यो अ॑नि॒ध्मो दी॒दय॑द॒प्स्व॑१न्तर्यं विप्रा॑स॒ ईड॑ते अध्व॒रेषु॑
अपां॑ नपा॒न्मधु॑मतीर॒पो दा॒ याभि॒रिन्द्रो॑ वावृ॒धे वी॒र्याऽवान्
lines_iast: yo a̭ni̱dhmo dī̱daya̭da̱psva̭1ntaryaṃ viprā̭sa̱ īḍa̭te adhva̱reṣṷ
apā̭ṃ napā̱nmadhṷmatīra̱po dā̱ yābhi̱rindro̭ vāvṛ̱dhe vī̱ryā'vān

hindi: इस चमकते हुए, शरीर को दूषित करने वाले ग्राभ को मैं दूर करता हूँ; जो कल्याणकारी और दीप्तिमान है, उसे मैं ऊपर उठाता हूँ।
english: This bright grasp (grābha) that defiles the body I remove; that which is auspicious and shining, that I raise up.
notes: 'grābha' (seizing, grasp) is kept literal; its precise sense here is unclear. 'udacāmi' taken as ud + √añc (raise); alternative derivation possible. 'ruśantam' could qualify grābham as 'bright' or be read as 'shining/white'.
lines_deva: इ॒दम॒हं रुश॑न्तं ग्रा॒भं त॑नू॒दूषि॒मपो॑हामि
यो भ॒द्रो रो॑च॒नस्तमुद॑चामि
lines_iast: i̱dama̱haṃ ruśa̭ntaṃ grā̱bhaṃ ta̭nū̱dūṣi̱mapo̭hāmi
yo bha̱dro ro̭ca̱nastamuda̭cāmi

hindi: इसके लिए ब्राह्मण स्नान के जल लाएँ; वे उन जलों को ऊपर खींच लाएँ जो वीरों का वध नहीं करते। अर्यमा की अग्नि के चारों ओर जाए; हे पूषन्, ससुर और देवर प्रतीक्षा कर रहे हैं।
english: Let the Brāhmaṇas bring for her the bathing waters; let them draw up the waters that do not slay men. Let (her) go around Aryaman's fire; O Pūṣan, the father-in-law and the husband's brother are waiting.
notes: Subject of 'paryetu' is not expressed (the woman addressed in 'asyai'). 'ā ... harantu' is a split verb. Whether 'snapanīḥ' and 'avīraghnīḥ' both qualify 'āpaḥ', and the sense of 'ud ajantu', are doubtful.
lines_deva: आस्यै॑ ब्राह्म॒णाः स्नप॑नीर्हर॒न्त्ववी॑रघ्नी॒रुद॑ज॒न्त्वापः॑
अ॒र्य॒म्णो अ॒ग्निं पर्ये॑तु पूष॒न् प्रती॑क्षन्ते॒ श्वशु॑रो दे॒वर॑श्च
lines_iast: āsyai̭ brāhma̱ṇāḥ snapa̭nīrhara̱ntvavī̭raghnī̱ruda̭ja̱ntvāpa̭ḥ
a̱rya̱mṇo a̱gniṃ paryḙtu pūṣa̱n pratī̭kṣante̱ śvaśṷro de̱vara̭śca

hindi: तुम्हारे लिए सोना कल्याणकारी हो, जल कल्याणकारी हों, खम्भा कल्याणकारी हो, जुए का छिद्र कल्याणकारी हो। तुम्हारे लिए सौ पवित्र करने वाले जल कल्याणकारी हों, और पति के साथ अपने शरीर का स्पर्श करो।
english: May gold be a blessing for you, and may the waters be a blessing; may the post be a blessing, may the hole of the yoke be a blessing. May the waters of a hundred purifiers be a blessing for you; and touch your body together with your husband.
notes: 'methi' (post) and 'tardma' (hole or borer, from tardman) are doubtful in sense; 'śam' is taken as a noun 'well-being' with 'bhavatu/santu'. 'śamu' = śam u.
lines_deva: शं ते॒ हिर॑ण्यं॒ शमु॑ स॒न्त्वापः॒ शं मे॒थिर्भ॑वतु॒ शं यु॒गस्य॒ तर्द्म॑
शं त॒ आपः॑ श॒तप॑वित्रा भवन्तु॒ शमु॒ पत्या॑ त॒न्वं॑१ सं स्पृ॑शस्व
lines_iast: śaṃ te̱ hira̭ṇya̱ṃ śamṷ sa̱ntvāpa̱ḥ śaṃ me̱thirbha̭vatu̱ śaṃ yu̱gasya̱ tardma̭
śaṃ ta̱ āpa̭ḥ śa̱tapa̭vitrā bhavantu̱ śamu̱ patyā̭ ta̱nva̭ṃ1 saṃ spṛ̭śasva

hindi: रथ के छिद्र में, गाड़ी के छिद्र में, जुए के छिद्र में, हे शतक्रतु; हे इन्द्र, अपाला को तीन बार शुद्ध करके तुमने सूर्य के समान त्वचा वाली बनाया।
english: In the hole of the chariot, in the hole of the cart, in the hole of the yoke, O Śatakratu: O Indra, having purified Apālā thrice, you made her sun-skinned.
notes: 'kha' is rendered 'hole' (also 'space/aperture'). Line a gives only the three locatives; its link to line b is not stated. Apālā is kept as a name; nothing is imported about her.
lines_deva: खे रथ॑स्य॒ खेऽन॑सः॒ खे यु॒गस्य॑ शतक्रतो
अ॒पा॒लामि॑न्द्र॒ त्रिष्पू॒त्वाकृ॑णोः॒ सूर्य॑त्वचम्
lines_iast: khe ratha̭sya̱ khe'na̭sa̱ḥ khe yu̱gasya̭ śatakrato
a̱pā̱lāmi̭ndra̱ triṣpū̱tvākṛ̭ṇo̱ḥ sūrya̭tvacam

words.gram: pres. part. mid. f. nom. sg. ā-√śās

hindi: सौमनस्य, सन्तान, सौभाग्य और धन की कामना करती हुई, पति की अनुव्रता होकर, अमरत्व के लिए, सुख के लिए, कमर कस ले।
english: Wishing for good-will, offspring, good fortune and wealth, having become devoted to your husband, gird yourself for immortality, for well-being.
notes: 'saṃ nahyasva' taken as 'bind/gird yourself (for the task)'; 'kam' read as 'for well-being' (a particle). 'amṛtāya' = for immortality (literal).
lines_deva: आ॒शासा॑ना सौमन॒सं प्र॒जां सौभा॑ग्यं र॒यिम्
पत्यु॒रनु॑व्रता भू॒त्वा सं न॑ह्यस्वा॒मृता॑य॒ कम्
lines_iast: ā̱śāsā̭nā saumana̱saṃ pra̱jāṃ saubhā̭gyaṃ ra̱yim
patyu̱ranṷvratā bhū̱tvā saṃ na̭hyasvā̱mṛtā̭ya̱ kam

hindi: जैसे वृषभ-रूप सिन्धु ने नदियों का साम्राज्य उत्पन्न किया है, वैसे ही तुम पति के घर जाकर साम्राज्ञी बनो।
english: As the Sindhu, the bull, has brought forth sovereignty over the rivers, so you, having gone to your husband's home, be queen.
notes: 'suṣuve' (√sū) is literally 'has set in motion / brought forth'; 'has won' is a free rendering. 'Sindhu' may be read as 'river' in general. 'paretya' taken as para + etya (having gone forth).
lines_deva: यथा॒ सिन्धु॑र्न॒दीनां॒ साम्रा॑ज्यं सुषु॒वे वृषा॑
ए॒वा त्वं स॒म्राज्ञ्ये॑धि॒ पत्यु॒रस्तं॑ प॒रेत्य॑
lines_iast: yathā̱ sindhṷrna̱dīnā̱ṃ sāmrā̭jyaṃ suṣu̱ve vṛṣā̭
e̱vā tvaṃ sa̱mrājñyḙdhi̱ patyu̱rasta̭ṃ pa̱retya̭

hindi: ससुरों में साम्राज्ञी बनो और देवरों में भी साम्राज्ञी बनो; ननद की साम्राज्ञी बनो और सास की भी साम्राज्ञी बनो।
english: Be queen among the fathers-in-law, and queen also among the husband's brothers; be queen of the husband's sister, and queen also of the mother-in-law.
notes: 'śvaśureṣu' plural of 'father-in-law' (may include the in-law elders generally). The genitives 'nanānduḥ' and 'śvaśrvāḥ' are taken as genitives of rule ('queen over').
lines_deva: स॒म्राज्ञ्ये॑धि॒ श्वशु॑रेषु स॒म्राज्ञ्यु॒त दे॒वृषु॑
नना॑न्दुः स॒म्राज्ञ्ये॑धि स॒म्राज्ञ्यु॒त श्व॒श्र्वाः
lines_iast: sa̱mrājñyḙdhi̱ śvaśṷreṣu sa̱mrājñyu̱ta de̱vṛṣṷ
nanā̭nduḥ sa̱mrājñyḙdhi sa̱mrājñyu̱ta śva̱śrvāḥ

hindi: जिन्होंने काटा, बुना और फैलाया, जिन देवियों ने चारों ओर किनारे दिए — वे तुम्हें बुढ़ापे तक ढकें। हे आयुष्मती, यह वस्त्र पहन लो।
english: Those who cut, who wove, and who stretched out, the goddesses who gave the ends all around: may they clothe you together for old age. O long-lived one, put on this garment.
notes: The token 'vyayantvāyuṣmatīdaṃ' = vyayantu + āyuṣmatī + idam. 'adadanta' (√dā) is doubtful: 'gave' or 'bound'. 'jarase' = for (reaching) old age.
lines_deva: या अकृ॑न्त॒न्नव॑य॒न् याश्च॑ तत्नि॒रे या दे॒वीरन्तां॑ अ॒भितोऽद॑दन्त
तास्त्वा॑ ज॒रसे॒ सं व्य॑य॒न्त्वायु॑ष्मती॒दं परि॑ धत्स्व॒ वासः॑
lines_iast: yā akṛ̭nta̱nnava̭ya̱n yāśca̭ tatni̱re yā de̱vīrantā̭ṃ a̱bhito'da̭danta
tāstvā̭ ja̱rase̱ saṃ vya̭ya̱ntvāyṷṣmatī̱daṃ pari̭ dhatsva̱ vāsa̭ḥ

hindi: जीवित के लिए वे रोते हैं, यज्ञ का संचालन करते हैं; लम्बे विस्तार के साथ-साथ पुरुषों ने ध्यान किया है। जिन्होंने पितरों के लिए यह प्रिय वस्तु चलाई है — पतियों के लिए, पत्नी के लिए, आलिङ्गन के लिए आनन्द।
english: They weep for the living one; they conduct the sacrifice; along the long extension the men have contemplated. Those who have set this lovely thing in motion for the fathers (grant) joy for the husbands, for the wife, for the embrace.
notes: Hard verse; sense uncertain. 'prasiti' (extension, stretch; also 'bond') is kept literal. Verb of line b is not expressed: 'mayaḥ' (joy) is read as the object of an implied 'give'. 'janaye' read as dative of 'jani' (wife).
lines_deva: जी॒वं रु॑दन्ति॒ वि न॑यन्त्यध्व॒रं दी॒र्घामनु॒ प्रसि॑तिं दीध्यु॒र्नरः॑
वा॒मं पि॒तृभ्यो॒ य इ॒दं स॑मीरि॒रे मयः॒ पति॑भ्यो ज॒नये॑ परि॒ष्वजे॑
lines_iast: jī̱vaṃ rṷdanti̱ vi na̭yantyadhva̱raṃ dī̱rghāmanu̱ prasi̭tiṃ dīdhyu̱rnara̭ḥ
vā̱maṃ pi̱tṛbhyo̱ ya i̱daṃ sa̭mīri̱re maya̱ḥ pati̭bhyo ja̱nayḙ pari̱ṣvajḙ

hindi: सन्तान के लिए मैं तुम्हारे लिए एक सुखद, दृढ़ पत्थर देवी पृथ्वी की गोद में स्थापित करता हूँ। उस पर खड़ी हो, हे आनन्द मनाने योग्य, उत्तम तेज वाली; सविता तुम्हारी आयु दीर्घ करे।
english: For offspring I set for you a comfortable, firm stone in the lap of the divine Earth. Stand on it, you who are to be rejoiced over, of good splendour; may Savitṛ make your life long.
notes: 'anumādyā' (anu-√mad, gerundive) is doubtful: 'to be rejoiced over' / 'delightful'. The first token of line b, 'tamā', is tam + ā.
lines_deva: स्यो॒नं ध्रु॒वं प्र॒जायै॑ धारयामि॒ तेऽश्मा॑नं दे॒व्याः पृ॑थि॒व्या उ॒पस्थे॑
तमा ति॑ष्ठानु॒माद्या॑ सु॒वर्चा॑ दी॒र्घं त॒ आयुः॑ सवि॒ता कृ॑णोतु
lines_iast: syo̱naṃ dhru̱vaṃ pra̱jāyai̭ dhārayāmi̱ te'śmā̭naṃ de̱vyāḥ pṛ̭thi̱vyā u̱pasthḙ
tamā ti̭ṣṭhānu̱mādyā̭ su̱varcā̭ dī̱rghaṃ ta̱ āyṷḥ savi̱tā kṛ̭ṇotu

hindi: जिससे अग्नि ने इस भूमि का दाहिना हाथ पकड़ा, उसी से मैं तुम्हारा हाथ पकड़ता हूँ; मेरे साथ, सन्तान और धन के साथ व्याकुल मत होओ।
english: With which Agni seized the right hand of this earth, with that I take your hand; do not be distressed, (but be) with me, with offspring and with wealth.

text_flags.why: possible: 'ye nāgnir' = 'yena agniḥ' (by which Agni) with a stray space after 'ye'

notes: Line b is considerably longer than line a (possibly two pādas). 'tena' (with that) refers back to the 'yena' of line a, taken as the clasp of the hand. 'mā vyathiṣṭhāḥ ... mayā saha' is rendered as 'do not be distressed, (be) with me ...'.
lines_deva: ये ना॒ग्निर॒स्या भूम्या॒ हस्तं॑ ज॒ग्राह॒ दक्षि॑णम्
तेन॑ गृह्णामि ते॒ हस्तं॒ मा व्य॑थिष्ठा॒ मया॑ स॒ह प्र॒जया॑ च॒ धने॑न च
lines_iast: ye nā̱gnira̱syā bhūmyā̱ hasta̭ṃ ja̱grāha̱ dakṣi̭ṇam
tena̭ gṛhṇāmi te̱ hasta̱ṃ mā vya̭thiṣṭhā̱ mayā̭ sa̱ha pra̱jayā̭ ca̱ dhanḙna ca

hindi: देव सविता तुम्हारा हाथ पकड़े; राजा सोम तुम्हें उत्तम सन्तान वाली करे। जातवेदा अग्नि पति के लिए पत्नी को सौभाग्यवती और बुढ़ापे तक जीने वाली करे।
english: May the god Savitṛ take your hand; may King Soma make you rich in offspring. May Agni Jātavedas make the wife fortunate for her husband and one who reaches old age.
notes: The accusatives 'suprajasam', 'subhagām', 'jaradaṣṭim' qualify the woman addressed ('you', 'the wife'). 'jaradaṣṭi' = (one whose span extends) to old age.
lines_deva: दे॒वस्ते॑ सवि॒ता हस्तं॑ गृह्णातु॒ सोमो॒ राजा॑ सुप्र॒जसं॑ कृणोतु
अ॒ग्निः सु॒भगां॑ ज॒तवे॑दाः॒ पत्ये॒ पत्नीं॑ ज॒रद॑ष्टिं कृणोतु
lines_iast: de̱vastḙ savi̱tā hasta̭ṃ gṛhṇātu̱ somo̱ rājā̭ supra̱jasa̭ṃ kṛṇotu
a̱gniḥ su̱bhagā̭ṃ ja̱tavḙdā̱ḥ patye̱ patnī̭ṃ ja̱rada̭ṣṭiṃ kṛṇotu

hindi: सौभाग्य के लिए मैं तुम्हारा हाथ पकड़ता हूँ, ताकि मुझ पति के साथ तुम बुढ़ापे तक जीने वाली होओ। भग, अर्यमा, सविता और पुरन्धि — इन देवों ने तुम्हें गृहस्थ-स्वामित्व के लिए मुझे दिया।
english: I take your hand for good fortune, that with me as husband you may reach old age. Bhaga, Aryaman, Savitṛ, Purandhi: the gods gave you to me for mastery of the household.
notes: 'Purandhi' kept as a name (literally 'bounty'). 'gārhapatya' here is household mastery (not the fire of that name).
lines_deva: गृ॒ह्णामि॑ ते सौभग॒त्वाय॒ हस्तं॒ मया॒ पत्या॑ ज॒रद॑ष्टि॒र्यथासः॑
भगो॑ अर्य॒मा स॑वि॒ता पुरं॑धि॒र्मह्यं॑ त्वादु॒र्गार्ह॑पत्याय दे॒वाः
lines_iast: gṛ̱hṇāmi̭ te saubhaga̱tvāya̱ hasta̱ṃ mayā̱ patyā̭ ja̱rada̭ṣṭi̱ryathāsa̭ḥ
bhago̭ arya̱mā sa̭vi̱tā pura̭ṃdhi̱rmahya̭ṃ tvādu̱rgārha̭patyāya de̱vāḥ

hindi: भग ने तुम्हारा हाथ पकड़ा, सविता ने हाथ पकड़ा। तुम धर्म से पत्नी हो, मैं तुम्हारा गृहपति हूँ।
english: Bhaga took your hand; Savitṛ took your hand. By dharma you are the wife; I am your master of the house.
notes: 'dharmaṇā' is taken as 'by dharma (law, established order)'.
lines_deva: भग॑स्ते॒ हस्त॑मग्रहीत् सवि॒ता हस्त॑मग्रहीत्
पत्नी॒ त्वम॑सि॒ धर्म॑णा॒हं गृ॒हप॑ति॒स्तव॑
lines_iast: bhaga̭ste̱ hasta̭magrahīt savi̱tā hasta̭magrahīt
patnī̱ tvama̭si̱ dharma̭ṇā̱haṃ gṛ̱hapa̭ti̱stava̭

hindi: यह मेरी हो, पालन करने योग्य; बृहस्पति ने तुम्हें मुझे दिया। हे सन्तान वाली, मुझ पति के साथ सौ शरद जीओ।
english: Let this one be mine, to be cherished; Bṛhaspati gave you to me. With me as husband, O you rich in offspring, live together a hundred autumns.
notes: 'poṣyā' read as 'one to be nourished/cherished'. 'śaradaḥ' autumns, i.e. years. The first token 'mame̱yama̭stu̱' = mama + iyam + astu.
lines_deva: ममे॒यम॑स्तु॒ पोष्या॒ मह्यं॑ त्वादा॒द् बृह॒स्पतिः॑
मया॒ पत्या॑ प्रजावति॒ सं जी॑व श॒रदः॑ श॒तम्
lines_iast: mame̱yama̭stu̱ poṣyā̱ mahya̭ṃ tvādā̱d bṛha̱spati̭ḥ
mayā̱ patyā̭ prajāvati̱ saṃ jī̭va śa̱rada̭ḥ śa̱tam

hindi: त्वष्टा ने बृहस्पति और कवियों के निर्देश से शोभा के लिए वस्त्र को व्यवस्थित किया। उसी से सविता और भग इस स्त्री को सूर्या के समान सन्तान से आच्छादित करें।
english: Tvaṣṭṛ arranged the garment for beauty, by the instruction of Bṛhaspati and of the seers. With that, may Savitṛ and Bhaga clothe this woman with offspring, like Sūryā.
notes: 'kam' read as a particle of well-being. 'pari dhattām' is dual (Savitṛ and Bhaga). 'Clothe with offspring' is literal ('invest around with offspring'). 'kavīnām' = of the seers/poets.
lines_deva: त्वष्टा॒ वासो॒ व्यदधाच्छु॒भे कं बृह॒स्पतेः॑ प्र॒शिषा॑ कवी॒नाम्
तेने॒मां नारीं॑ सवि॒ता भग॑श्च सू॒र्यामि॑व॒ परि॑ धत्तां प्र॒जया॑
lines_iast: tvaṣṭā̱ vāso̱ vyadadhācchu̱bhe kaṃ bṛha̱spatḙḥ pra̱śiṣā̭ kavī̱nām
tene̱māṃ nārī̭ṃ savi̱tā bhaga̭śca sū̱ryāmi̭va̱ pari̭ dhattāṃ pra̱jayā̭

hindi: इन्द्र और अग्नि, द्युलोक और पृथ्वी, मातरिश्वा, मित्र और वरुण, भग, दोनों अश्विन्, बृहस्पति, मरुत्, ब्रह्म और सोम — ये इस स्त्री को सन्तान से बढ़ाएँ।
english: May Indra and Agni, Heaven and Earth, Mātariśvan, Mitra and Varuṇa, Bhaga, both Aśvins, Bṛhaspati, the Maruts, the sacred utterance and Soma make this woman grow with offspring.
notes: 'brahma' (n.) read as 'sacred utterance'; alternative: a priest or the deity Brahmā (not in the Sanskrit form given). Plural verb after many subjects.
lines_deva: इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्नी द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी मा॑त॒रिश्वा॑ मि॒त्रावरु॑णा॒ भगो॑ अ॒श्विनो॒भा
बृह॒स्पति॑र्म॒रुतो॒ ब्रह्म॒ सोम॑ इ॒मां नारीं॑ प्र॒जया॑ वर्धयन्तु
lines_iast: i̱ndrā̱gnī dyāvā̭pṛthi̱vī mā̭ta̱riśvā̭ mi̱trāvarṷṇā̱ bhago̭ a̱śvino̱bhā
bṛha̱spati̭rma̱ruto̱ brahma̱ soma̭ i̱māṃ nārī̭ṃ pra̱jayā̭ vardhayantu

hindi: बृहस्पति ने सबसे पहले सूर्या के सिर पर केश सजाए; उसी से, हे अश्विनो, हम इस स्त्री को पति के लिए सजाते हैं।
english: Bṛhaspati first arranged the hair on Sūryā's head; with that, O Aśvins, we adorn this woman for her husband.
notes: 'akalpayat' read as 'arranged' (also 'fashioned/set in order').
lines_deva: बृह॒स्पतिः॑ प्रथ॒मः सू॒र्यायाः॑ शी॒र्षे केशां॑ अकल्पयत्
तेने॒माम॑श्विना॒ नारीं॒ पत्ये॒ सं शो॑भयामसि
lines_iast: bṛha̱spati̭ḥ pratha̱maḥ sū̱ryāyā̭ḥ śī̱rṣe keśā̭ṃ akalpayat
tene̱māma̭śvinā̱ nārī̱ṃ patye̱ saṃ śo̭bhayāmasi

words.gloss: with the Navagvas (name of a group)

hindi: यह वही रूप है जिसे युवती ने धारण किया है; मैं मन से विचरती हुई पत्नी को जानना चाहता हूँ। मैं नवग्वा मित्रों के साथ उसके पीछे चलूँगा। कौन जानने वाला इन पाशों को खोल चुका है?
english: This is that form which the young woman has put on; I wish to know the wife who moves about with the mind. I shall follow her with my friends, the Navagvas. Who, knowing, has loosened these bonds?
notes: 'avasta' (√vas, to clothe) and 'manasā carantīm' ('moving with the mind'/'in thought') are uncertain. 'Navagva' kept as a name of a group, not explained. The speaker changes in the verse and is not named. 'ka' = kaḥ; 'cacarta' read as perfect of √kṛt (cut, loosen).
lines_deva: इ॒दं तद् रू॒पं यदव॑स्त॒ योषा॑ जा॒यां जि॑ज्ञासे॒ मन॑सा॒ चर॑न्तीम्
तामन्व॑र्तिष्ये॒ सखि॑भि॒र्नव॑ग्वैः॒ क इ॒मान् वि॒द्वान् वि च॑चर्त॒ पाशा॑न्
lines_iast: i̱daṃ tad rū̱paṃ yadava̭sta̱ yoṣā̭ jā̱yāṃ ji̭jñāse̱ mana̭sā̱ cara̭ntīm
tāmanva̭rtiṣye̱ sakhi̭bhi̱rnava̭gvai̱ḥ ka i̱mān vi̱dvān vi ca̭carta̱ pāśā̭n

words.gram: pres. part. mid. m. nom. sg. √śrath

hindi: मैं खोलता हूँ; मुझमें इसका रूप है, मन के निवास को जानते हुए, देखते हुए। मैं चोरी की वस्तु नहीं खाता; मन से मैं मुक्त हुआ हूँ, स्वयं वरुण के पाशों को ढीला करता हुआ।
english: I loosen; in me is her form, knowing, seeing the abode of the mind. I do not eat what is stolen; by the mind I am freed, myself loosening the nooses of Varuṇa.
notes: Line a is uncertain: 'vedad it' (vedat + it) is read as 'knowing indeed'; its grammar is doubtful. 'steya' = what is stolen (or theft). 'kulāyam' = nest, abode. The speaker is the 'I' of the verse; not named. The preceding unit asks 'who, knowing, has loosened these bonds?'.
lines_deva: अ॒हं वि ष्या॑मि॒ मयि॑ रू॒पम॑स्या॒ वेद॒दित् पश्य॒न् मन॑सः कु॒लाय॑म्
न स्तेय॑मद्मि॒ मन॒सोद॑मुच्ये स्व॒यं श्र॑थ्ना॒नो वरु॑णस्य॒ पाशा॑न्
lines_iast: a̱haṃ vi ṣyā̭mi̱ mayi̭ rū̱pama̭syā̱ veda̱dit paśya̱n mana̭saḥ ku̱lāya̭m
na steya̭madmi̱ mana̱soda̭mucye sva̱yaṃ śra̭thnā̱no varṷṇasya̱ pāśā̭n

words.gloss: for the wife together (with the husband)

hindi: मैं तुम्हें वरुण के उस पाश से मुक्त करता हूँ, जिससे अति कृपालु सविता ने तुम्हें बाँधा था। हे वधू, मैं तुम्हारे लिए, पति के साथ रहने वाली पत्नी के लिए, यहाँ विशाल लोक और सुगम मार्ग बनाता हूँ।
english: I release you from the noose of Varuṇa, with which gracious Savitṛ bound you. For you, O bride, the wife together with her husband, I make here a wide world and an easy path.
notes: 'sahapatnyai' is uncertain: read as 'for the wife (who is) together with (her husband)'; alternative 'for the co-wife'. 'sugam atra' read as 'easy to go here' (a path); 'sugam' may qualify 'panthām'.
lines_deva: प्र त्वा॑ मुञ्चामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ पाशा॒द् येन॒ त्वाब॑ध्नात् सवि॒ता सु॒शेवाः॑
उ॒रुं लो॒कं सु॒गमत्र॒ पन्थां॑ कृ॒णोमि॒ तुभ्यं॑ स॒हप॑त्न्यै वधु
lines_iast: pra tvā̭ muñcāmi̱ varṷṇasya̱ pāśā̱d yena̱ tvāba̭dhnāt savi̱tā su̱śevā̭ḥ
u̱ruṃ lo̱kaṃ su̱gamatra̱ panthā̭ṃ kṛ̱ṇomi̱ tubhya̭ṃ sa̱hapa̭tnyai vadhu

words.gloss: in the good deed, the well-done

words.gram: pres. part. m. nom. sg. pra-√jñā

hindi: उठो, रक्षस् को दूर मारो, इस स्त्री को सुकृत में स्थापित करो। बुद्धिमान धाता ने इसके लिए पति पाया; जानते हुए राजा भग आगे-आगे चले।
english: Rise up, strike away the rakṣas (harmful beings), place this woman in the well-done (good deed). The wise Dhātṛ found a husband for her; let King Bhaga, knowing, go in front.
notes: 'hanātha' is an irregular 2 pl. imperative of √han. 'sukṛte' literally 'in the good deed' (the realm of what is well done). The Sanskrit 'rakṣas' kept as 'harmful being' (glossary). 'vipaścit' = wise.
lines_deva: उद्य॑च्छध्व॒मप॒ रक्षो॑ हनाथे॒मं नारीं॑ सुकृ॒ते द॑धात
धा॒ता वि॑प॒श्चित् पति॑म॒स्यै वि॑वेद॒ भगो॒ राजा॑ पु॒र ए॑तु प्रजा॒नन्
lines_iast: udya̭cchadhva̱mapa̱ rakṣo̭ hanāthe̱maṃ nārī̭ṃ sukṛ̱te da̭dhāta
dhā̱tā vi̭pa̱ścit pati̭ma̱syai vi̭veda̱ bhago̱ rājā̭ pu̱ra ḙtu prajā̱nan

hindi: भग ने चार पाए गढ़े, भग ने चार उष्पल गढ़े; त्वष्टा ने बीच से आगे रस्सियों को सजाया। वह हमारे लिए अत्यन्त मङ्गलकारिणी हो।
english: Bhaga fashioned the four feet; Bhaga fashioned the four uṣpalas; Tvaṣṭṛ decked the straps from the middle onward. May she be very auspicious for us.
notes: 'uṣpala' is an unclear word; kept untranslated. 'pādān' = feet or legs (of an object not named). 'vardhra' = strap/thong. The referent of 'sā' (she) is not named in the unit.
lines_deva: भग॑स्ततक्ष च॒तुरः॒ पादा॒न् भग॑स्ततक्ष च॒त्वार्युष्प॑लानि
त्वष्टा॑ पिपेश मध्य॒तोऽनु॒ वर्ध्रा॒न्त्सा नो॑ अस्तु सुमङ्ग॒ली
lines_iast: bhaga̭statakṣa ca̱tura̱ḥ pādā̱n bhaga̭statakṣa ca̱tvāryuṣpa̭lāni
tvaṣṭā̭ pipeśa madhya̱to'nu̱ vardhrā̱ntsā no̭ astu sumaṅga̱lī

hindi: उत्तम किंशुक वाले, सब रूपों वाले, सुनहरे रङ्ग के, सुन्दर घूमने वाले, अच्छे चक्कों वाले वहतु पर चढ़ो, हे सूर्या, अमर के लोक पर; तुम पतियों के लिए सुखद वहतु बनाओ।
english: Mount, O Sūryā, the conveyance of fine kiṃśuka, of every form, gold-coloured, well-rolling, with good wheels, the world of the immortal; make a pleasant conveyance for the husbands.
notes: 'kiṃśuka' is kept as a plant name (not identified). 'vahatu' glossed 'conveyance/bridal procession'. The relation of 'amṛtasya lokam' to the conveyance is not clear; 'lokam' taken as a second object of 'ā roha'.
lines_deva: सु॒किं॒शु॒कं व॑ह॒तुं वि॒श्वरू॑पं॒ हिर॑ण्यवर्णं सु॒वृतं॑ सुच॒क्रम्
आ रो॑ह सूर्ये अ॒मृत॑स्य लो॒कं स्यो॒नं पति॑भ्यो वह॒तुं कृ॑णु॒ त्वम्
lines_iast: su̱ki̱ṃśu̱kaṃ va̭ha̱tuṃ vi̱śvarṷ̄pa̱ṃ hira̭ṇyavarṇaṃ su̱vṛta̭ṃ suca̱kram
ā ro̭ha sūrye a̱mṛta̭sya lo̱kaṃ syo̱naṃ pati̭bhyo vaha̱tuṃ kṛ̭ṇu̱ tvam

hindi: भाइयों का वध न करने वाली, हे वरुण, पशुओं का वध न करने वाली, हे बृहस्पति, पति का वध न करने वाली, हे इन्द्र, पुत्रों वाली को, हे सविता, हमारे लिए ले आओ।
english: One who does not kill brothers, O Varuṇa; one who does not kill cattle, O Bṛhaspati; one who does not kill a husband, O Indra; one with sons: bring her to us, O Savitṛ.
notes: The object of 'vaha' is the woman described by the four accusatives (not named). The deities addressed in the first half are vocatives of address spread across the epithets.
lines_deva: अभ्रा॑तृघ्नीं वरु॒णाप॑शुघ्नीं बृहस्पते
इन्द्राप॑तिघ्नीं पु॒त्रिणी॒मास्मभ्यं॑ सवितर्वह
lines_iast: abhrā̭tṛghnīṃ varu̱ṇāpa̭śughnīṃ bṛhaspate
indrāpa̭tighnīṃ pu̱triṇī̱māsmabhya̭ṃ savitarvaha

hindi: हे दोनों खम्भो, देवों द्वारा बनाए गए मार्ग पर कन्या को हानि मत पहुँचाओ। हम दिव्य गृह के द्वार को वधू के लिए सुखद मार्ग बनाते हैं।
english: Do not harm the girl, you two posts, on the path made by the gods. We make the door of the divine house a pleasant bride's path.
notes: 'kumāryam' (with svarita digit 1) taken as a variant accusative of 'kumārī'. 'sthūṇe' is dual (two posts, perhaps of the doorway). Line b: 'syonam' taken as predicate of 'vadhūpatham'; alternative: 'we make the door pleasant, the bride's path'.
lines_deva: मा हिं॑सिष्टं कुमा॒र्यं॑१ स्थूणे॑ दे॒वकृ॑ते प॒थि
शाला॑या दे॒व्या द्वारं॑ स्यो॒नं कृ॑ण्मो वधूप॒थम्
lines_iast: mā hi̭ṃsiṣṭaṃ kumā̱rya̭ṃ1 sthūṇḙ de̱vakṛ̭te pa̱thi
śālā̭yā de̱vyā dvāra̭ṃ syo̱naṃ kṛ̭ṇmo vadhūpa̱tham

hindi: पीछे ब्रह्म जुड़े, आगे ब्रह्म; अन्त में ब्रह्म, मध्य में ब्रह्म, सब ओर ब्रह्म। अपीड़ित देवपुरी में प्रवेश करके कल्याणकारी और सुखद होकर पतिलोक में विराजो।
english: Let sacred utterance be joined behind, sacred utterance before; sacred utterance at the end, in the middle, on every side. Having entered the unharmed city of the gods, kind and pleasant, shine forth in your husband's world.
notes: 'brahma' (n.) read as 'sacred utterance'; alternative 'the prayer / the holy power'. 'anāvyādhām' = not to be pierced or harmed; 'devapurām' = city of the gods.
lines_deva: ब्रह्माप॑रं यु॒ज्यतां॒ ब्रह्म॒ पूर्वं॒ ब्रह्मा॑न्त॒तो म॑ध्य॒तो ब्रह्म॑ स॒र्वतः॑
अ॒ना॒व्या॒धां दे॑वपु॒रां प्र॒पद्य॑ शि॒वा स्यो॒ना प॑तिलो॒के वि रा॑ज
lines_iast: brahmāpa̭raṃ yu̱jyatā̱ṃ brahma̱ pūrva̱ṃ brahmā̭nta̱to ma̭dhya̱to brahma̭ sa̱rvata̭ḥ
a̱nā̱vyā̱dhāṃ dḙvapu̱rāṃ pra̱padya̭ śi̱vā syo̱nā pa̭tilo̱ke vi rā̭ja
